title: Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Matun
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in Berakhot 7b: “It was also taught so: Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Matun says: It is permitted to provoke the wicked in this world.” But in Derekh Eretz Rabbah, chapter 2, the statement is attributed to Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Yehudah.

And what we find in Yoma 30b, “Rabbi Dostai bar Matun said that Rabbi Yochanan said,” Hyman calls a scribal error and proposes Rabbi Yustai bar Matun, as in Zevachim 99, and so Dikdukei Soferim cites the reading on Berakhot 7b.

notes.text: The consulted Yoma 30b reads Dostai bar Matun, whereas Zevachim 99a reads Yostai son of Rabbi Matun. Hyman’s proposed correction and his report of the Dikdukei Soferim reading remain his; that exact edition was not directly inspected.
